author: Ari Koslow
title: Michael Harris II (back) not in lineup Wednesday
desc: Michael Harris II is not in the lineup for the second game of Wednesday's doubleheader against the Giants.
impact: Harris made an early exit from Tuesday's game before it was suspended. He remains day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyler Heineman traded to Angels
desc: The Blue Jays traded Tyler Heineman to the Angels for cash considerations.
impact: Heineman had been designated for assignment by Toronto. He will add depth behind the plate for the Angels.

author: Chase Davis
title: JJ Wetherholt picks up three hits, steal in win
desc: JJ Wetherholt went 3-for-4 in a win over the Padres with one walk and one stolen base.
impact: After Tuesday's win, Wetherholt is batting .259 with 10 home runs, 31 RBI, 45 runs scored and eight stolen bases across 67 games. He's eighth among rookies in steals, tied-fourth in home runs, and second in runs scored.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Josh Naylor (wrist) hopeful to be back in lineup Thursday
desc: Mariners manager Dan Wilson said the team is hopeful Josh Naylor will be back in the lineup on Thursday.
impact: Naylor remains out of the lineup on Wednesday and day-to-day for now.

author: Chase Davis
title: Riley O'Brien locks down save as Cards edge Padres
desc: Riley O'Brien walked one batter in a scoreless frame to earn the save in Tuesday's 3-2 win over the Padres.
impact: After Tuesday's win, O'Brien now has a 3.73 ERA and 1.21 WHIP with 18 saves, four blown saves and one hold across 31 appearances. This was a nice bounce-back after he was all over the place in his last outing, leading to three walks. He's tied for third in the league in saves.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Spencer Strider (elbow) transferred to 60-day IL
desc: The Braves transferred Spencer Strider to the 60-day injured list.
impact: The move opens up a spot on the 40-man roster for Atlanta. Strider has been shut down from throwing for at least the next four weeks.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Randy Dobnak traded to Royals
desc: The Kansas City Royals are acquiring right-hander Randy Dobnak from the Mariners.
impact: Dobnak exercised an upward-mobility clause in his contract. He will report to Triple-A Omaha and be added to the Royals 40-man roster.

author: Chase Davis
title: Andre Pallante grinds out seven strong in 3-2 win
desc: Andre Pallante allowed two earned runs on four hits and no walks while striking out six over seven innings in Tuesday's win over the Padres.
impact: After the victory, Pallante now owns a 3.76 ERA and 1.20 WHIP with an 8-4 record across 14 starts this season. He allowed six hard-hit balls and picked up six whiffs on 92 pitches. This was his second quality start in a row and fifth on the year. He'll face the Diamondbacks next time through the rotation.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Andrew Painter optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Phillies optioned Andrew Painter to Triple-A.
impact: Painter's recent struggles continued on Wednesday in a loss against the Marlins. He'll look to work on some things in Triple-A before he gets another opportunity in the majors.

author: Chase Davis
title: Bobby Witt Jr. steals league-leading 27th bag
desc: Bobby Witt Jr. went 3-for-4 in loss to the Nationals with a walk, one run scored, one RBI and one stolen base.
impact: After Tuesday's loss to Washington, Witt is batting .290 with nine home runs, 29 RBI, 38 runs scored and 27 steals across 74 games. It's been 19 games since his last homer, and that's after starting the year with a 27-game homer drought.

author: Chase Davis
title: Lane Thomas goes deep but can't save KC in 6-4 loss
desc: Lane Thomas went 1-for-3 in loss to the Nationals with a home run, two walks, two runs scored and one RBI.
impact: Through 59 games, Thomas is batting .225 with four homers, 17 RBI, 16 runs scored and three stolen bases. He's started seven of his team's last nine games, but is only batting .222 with two homers and five runs scored.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luis Morales optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Athletics optioned Luis Morales to Triple-A Las Vegas.
impact: Morales was just recalled to start the week. He will head back to Triple-A to make room for Aaron Civale.

author: Chase Davis
title: Daniel Lynch takes first loss of season
desc: Daniel Lynch allowed three earned runs on two hits and two walks while striking out one batter in the Royals' 6-4 loss to the Nationals.
impact: After Tuesday's loss, Lynch now has a 2.61 ERA and 1.00 WHIP with an 8.7 K/9, one save and nine holds across 31 appearances. He entered the game in relief for Michael Wacha and gave up two walks, a home run and a single before recording his second out. He's been mostly good this year, but has struggled in June when the Royals are searching for some consistency.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Aaron Civale (shoulder) activated from IL
desc: The Athletics activated Aaron Civale from the 15-day injured list.
impact: Civale will make his return on Wednesday against the Pirates. He has been sidelined since May 26 with right shoulder tendinitis.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Seth Halvorsen optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Rockies optioned RHP Seth Halvorsen to Triple-A Albuquerque.
impact: Halvorsen had posted a 3.31 ERA across 16 1/3 innings for the Rockies this season. He should get another opportunity later in the summer.
